The stickers you create or save on TikTok while scrolling stay locked inside TikTok: Whatik pulls them out of a screen recording or a link, converts them to WhatsApp\'s format and adds them as packs, one at a time or in bulk.
The easiest way: "Automatic capture from TikTok". Whatik shows a bubble over TikTok; when stickers are on screen tap the bubble and Whatik finds and adds them by itself.
Alternatively record the screen with the phone recorder and share the video with Whatik: moving stickers are detected on their own, press "Create all".
Got a direct link to a sticker (.awebp/.webp/.gif file) or to a page containing it? Use "From a link". Images already in the gallery are found by the automatic search.
Tap stickers to select them (or "Select all") and press "Copy to WhatsApp": packs are created and opened in WhatsApp (3 to 30 stickers per pack).

Whatik shows a bubble over TikTok. Go where stickers are visible (a video, the sticker panel, a chat) and tap the bubble: a radial menu opens. "Point" lets you tap the sticker to capture: Whatik frames the zone, locks the screen for 8 seconds (so you cannot scroll by mistake), records at 20 frames per second, measures the loop length and works out whether the sticker is animated or still. "All" grabs every animated sticker on screen at once. "End" or a long-press on the bubble closes the session.
